name: CZI Community Space
description: Free meeting and event space for nonprofits serving San Mateo County, including an event space for up to 200 people and two conference rooms
fullDescription: The Chan Zuckerberg Community Space in downtown Redwood City provides free meeting and event space for nonprofits serving San Mateo County, plus Redwood City and San Mateo County government agencies.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free event space (The Grove) for up to 200 people
- Two conference rooms (up to 20 and 12 people)
- Free WiFi, microphones, screens, and videoconferencing tools
- Multiple event layouts (theater, banquet, mix and mingle)
- Weekday day and evening events
- Members can book up to one year in advance
howToGetIt:
1. Be a Bay Area nonprofit that serves San Mateo County, or a Redwood City/San Mateo County government agency
2. Contact CZI through the Community Space website about membership
3. Once a member, check room availability on the online calendar
4. Submit a meeting request (up to one year in advance)
5. Follow the Community Space guidelines for your event
address: 801 Jefferson Avenue, Suite 100, Redwood City, CA 94063
keywords: CZI, Chan Zuckerberg, free meeting space, nonprofit venue, Redwood City, conference room, event space, coworking
